affordance_in_statement: It is guaranteed that the full catalog of m available cables forms a fully connected network on the n sites with exactly n - 1 cables. This structure guarantees that there is exactly one unique simple path ... between any pair of sites in the network.
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving removal: the tree/unique-path structure is the core of the task, and m = n - 1 plus connectivity forces it even if the guarantee is reworded.

common_affordance: The input graph is guaranteed to be a connected tree, so every essential-pair path is unique and the required retained set is their tree-path union.
recommended_edit: No effective edit exists without changing the task: replacing the tree guarantee with a general graph would be required to defeat all survivors, but that conflicts with the immutable m = n - 1 condition and changes the problem's structure.
